description: This file defines a Drupal Views style plugin class 'Serializer' that serializes view results into various formats using Symfony's Serializer component. It includes methods for configuration, rendering, cache management, and dependency calculation, specifically for serialized output formats within Drupal.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A Drupal Views style plugin class for serializing view results into various formats using Symfony's Serializer component.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the Serializer plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Serializer plugin with configuration, serializer service, formats, and providers.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the plugin, including 'formats'.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for selecting accepted request formats.

methods.name: submitOptionsForm
methods.description: Processes submitted form data to set the selected formats.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Serializes the view result rows into the selected format, handling entity normalization and response content type.

methods.name: getFormats
methods.description: Returns the currently configured serialization formats.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age as permanent.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates plugin dependencies, including format providers and serialization module.

methods.name: getFormatOptions
methods.description: Returns available format options as an array.
